name: Softwar/Extra
source:
Softwar/Extra is a submission to the first Renpy Jam, featuring the animatability of character sprites, GUI customization, textbox sounds, transitions and battle gameplay capabilities of Ren'py!

[From [url=https://zankizuna.itch.io/softwarextra]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Softwar/Extra》是第一届Ren’Py Jam的参赛作品，展示了Ren’Py在角色立绘动画、图形界面定制、文本框音效、转场以及战斗玩法方面的功能！

[摘自[url=https://zankizuna.itch.io/softwarextra]Itch.io[/url]]
